reels.caption:
A few weeks ago I visited the Doraemon 100 & Friends exhibition in Tokyo! 💙

There’s an outside area packed with more than 100 life-size Doraemon figures, all with different expressions, poses, and gadgets, so there are photo spots literally everywhere. There are also manga, anime, and movie-themed areas (inside the building), plus a few Japan-exclusive Doraemon designs 🥹

I was obsessed with the sakura Doraemon and the onigiri Doraemon plushies 🌸🍙 But you can only buy them after visiting the exhibition because you need a special code that you’ll find once you get to the shop… and of course I had to get them 😭✨

Visitors also receive random Doraemon acrylic pins and promo cards. If you’re in Tokyo before the end of September and grew up with Doraemon, this is such a fun and nostalgic stop 🫶🏻

🗓️ Until September 30, 2026!
📍Tokyo Dream Park

Japan’s viral sandwich scene with @foodtokyotourguide soft, fluffy, and impossibly aesthetic!🥪🇯🇵✨ Tag someone you’d go on a foodie hunt in Tokyo with!🍓💛

🥪 In Tokyo, Japanese “sando” sandwiches are all about perfection — from pillowy milk bread to beautifully layered fillings. Spots like Sando Lab Tokyo are known for their modern, picture-perfect creations, while Popo serves classic fruit sandos packed with fresh cream and seasonal fruits. Chermside Sandwich brings a more gourmet twist with unique flavors, and Pelican Cafe is loved for its iconic thick-cut bread and nostalgic café-style sandwiches.

📍 Tokyo, Japan
